selection_rule: Within each band and outcome, sort by (steps, episode_uid) and take the lower median rank (n-1)//2.  If the stratum is empty, substitute the highest-nDTW failure for a missing success or the lowest-nDTW success for a missing failure, and label it explicitly.

audit.interpretation: Within a deployment the frozen MEC model produces the same navigation action sequence for every association policy.  DQN/PPO can differ from the control only in node choices, E2E and RewardD; path, success and steps must be identical.  Across deployments the MEC model differs, so paths may differ.
